row.evidence: SolarWinds Service Desk docs say 'You can choose to create, update, and disable user accounts via user provisioning' (Entra, ADFS, Google, Okta, OneLogin), but no plan is named for provisioning and SolarWinds never documents a SCIM endpoint; only Okta's catalogue marks the app as SCIM.
row.notes: New row. SolarWinds is a multi-product vendor; this row covers SolarWinds Service Desk (formerly Samanage), the SaaS product with IdP user provisioning. SolarWinds Observability SaaS documents SAML only (no SCIM or JIT found); okta.com/integrations/solarwinds/ is a SAML-only app. Pricing is per technician (agent), unlimited requesters: Essentials $39, Advanced $99, Premier $124 per technician/mo billed annually. The compare page ticks Single Sign On (SSO) and API Access on all three plans. Status unknown: provisioning is documented but no page names the plan that includes it, and SolarWinds' own docs never say SCIM; the Okta OIN entry ticks SCIM (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push), while the Entra gallery connector points its Tenant URL at the REST API host api.samanage.com, so the Entra connector may use the proprietary REST API. Deprovisioning disables the user (Entra soft delete maps to disabled); users who ever logged in cannot be deleted. JIT on SAML via Okta is supported. API rate limits: Advanced 1000, Premier 1500 calls/min; Essentials has no listed limit.

auth.notes: Per-admin JSON Web Token sent as X-Samanage-Authorization: Bearer; token carries the generating admin's permissions and is disabled with that user.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via the user 'disabled' boolean on PUT /users/{id} (seen in the OpenAPI schema); role set via the user 'role' field.

endpoints.purpose: Update user (including disabled, role, site, department, reports_to)

audit_log_api.notes: GET /audits exists in the API reference; the compare page puts Audit History and Login & Email Audits on Advanced and Premier.

rate_limits.text: Per-minute limits by plan: Advanced 1000 calls/min, Premier 1500 calls/min (pricing card says up to 1,500 API calls/user/minute on Premier).

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SWA and SCIM; provisioning Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking, Schema Discovery.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'SolarWinds Service Desk (previously Samanage)'; Tenant URL is https://api.samanage.com (the REST API host) and the tutorial does not mention SCIM.

google.notes: Vendor docs list Google SSO and Google provisioning; no Google Workspace Marketplace page checked.

onelogin.notes: Vendor's users page lists OneLogin among user-provisioning integrations; OneLogin catalogue not checked (blocks bots).

fallbacks.other_sync: Microsoft Entra / ADFS / Google / Okta / OneLogin provisioning documented by vendor (protocol not named)
fallbacks.notes: Users page lists Import (CSV), Manual, User Provisioning, API script and portal self sign-up.
